IB MTS Result 2026 Out @mha.gov.in

Intelligence Bureau has officially declared IB MTS Result 2025-26 on April 13. The result shows the passing status of candidates who appeared for the exam on 27th January 2026. The provisional answer key for the IB MTS Tier 1 exam was released on 29th January 2026. Candidates who clear this test will be eligible to appear for Tier 2. The IB MTS Phase 2 dates have not yet been announced by the authority. Candidates who have qualified Tier 1 will be informed about Tier 2 admit card through email or SMS.

IB MTS Tier 1 Result 2026: Overview

The Intelligence Bureau, which comes under the Ministry of Home Affairs, released the MTS result for Tier 1 exam on 13 April 2026. The IB MTS exam was conducted to fill 362 posts. Candidates who have successfully cleared the CBT exam will be called in for the next stage of the exam. The IB MTS result is available online at mha.gov.in in PDF format.

IB MTS Result Download Link

IB MTS Result 2025-26 download link is now active on the official portal of Ministry of Home Affairs, at mha.gov.in. The IB MTS Tier 1 exam was held on 27th January 2026. The result is out in PDF format and candidates can download it from the link below and check there roll number. The result displays a list of roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the next stage of this recruitment.

IB MTS Result 2026- Click Here to Download

How to Download IB MTS Result 2026?

As the IB MTS 2025 Result has been declared, candidates can check their respective result through the link given above or by going to the official website. The result is available in PDF mode. Candidates can check for their roll no. in the result pdf to see their passing status.

Step 1: Go to the official website at mha.gov.in.

Step 2: On the home page, find the “What’s New” section.

Step 3: Click on the “IB MTS Result 2025 PDF”/ “Result of MTS Tier 1- IB 2025”

Step 4: Download the IB MTS 2026 Result PDF and save it for later.

What Happens After IB MTS Result 2026?

Candidates who pass the IB MTS Tier 1 exam will appear for the Tier 2 exam. The Intelligence Bureau is yet to release the phase 2 exam dates. Qualified candidates should buckle up for the tier 2 exam, as the authority may announce the exam dates anytime soon. The IB MTS Tier 2 is a descriptive exam and it focuses on the english language and comprehension.

IB MTS Tier 2 Exam Pattern 2026
Topic Marks Time Duration
English Language: Vocabulary, Grammar, Sentence Structure, Synonyms and Antonyms. Comprehension and Paragraph Writing in 150 words 50 60 minutes

IB MTS Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is IB MTS 2025-26 results out?

Ans. Yes the IB MTS result is out on April 13, 2026 at mha.gov.in.

Q2. Is IB MTS a good job?

Ans. Yes, IB MTS is a good job because of its good pay, job security and allowances.

Q3. My name is not there in the PDF. Does that mean I failed?

Ans. Yes, if your roll number is not in the IB MT Result 2026 PDF, it means that you haven’t cleared the exam.

Q4. Will IB sent the MTS result by SMS or email?

Ans. No. The Intelligence Bureau does not sent the results personally in SMS or email form. Candidates have to check their results online through the official website.

Q5. What is the next stage after the Tier 1 exam?

Ans. Students who successfully qualified the IB MTS Tier 1 exam will be appearing for the Tier 2 exam. Date for the same has not yet been announced by the authorities.
